 November Social Security direct payment worth $994 goes out in two days
 By Emily Danner 
 Published
 October 28, 2026 9:00am ET
 Advertisement -->
 Advertisement 
 Add Washington Examiner on Google
 Advertisement 
 The November 2026 Supplemental Security Income payments, worth up to $994, will be sent to recipients in two days.
 SSI payments are typically issued on the first day of each month. If the first day falls on a weekend or federal holiday, the payment is sent on the last business day of the previous month instead. Nov. 1 is a Sunday, so recipients will receive their benefits on Friday, Oct. 30.
